motion.name: selection-feedback

motion.purpose: Pointer-only cancellable WAAPI from opacity .7 and translateY(8px), after state and focus update. Keyboard/reduced motion skip it; reset and reduced-motion changes cancel it.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Shared CSS removes animations/transitions; Lune removes press transform. Menu and confirmation remain immediate.

refinement.scope: Modest Lune refinement superseding September layout and typography descriptions. Existing blue, ink and paper palette; Gloock wordmark, Manrope headings/body/controls. Corporate documentation remains separate.
refinement.hero: Paper 1fr 1.1fr grid with 72px gap: title and copy/actions left, one un-darkened room image spanning both rows right. Image height 520px, 480px at 1000px, 300px at 720px and 260px below 359px. Mobile stacks title, copy/actions and image. Circular food detail removed.
refinement.menu: Shorter copy and tighter menu: sticky food illustration beside a single-column list in .7fr 1.3fr columns with 72px gap; padding 72px/88px, 44px/56px on mobile. Categories remain underlined. Feature heading is Manrope 1.25rem, 1.1rem mobile. Mobile image/text pair is non-sticky with square image; narrow-phone imagery stacks in 4:3.
refinement.about: Compact blue copy-and-hours section, 1.2fr 1fr columns with 96px gap and 64px vertical padding; mobile stacks with 44px padding. Repeated room image removed.
refinement.booking: Full-width ink chapter and paper workspace. Native date, guest select and required radio times; live summary and written closed-day feedback. Workspace padding 36px, 28px at 1000px, 24px 20px at 720px; field gaps 26px 20px.
refinement.faq: Native details/summary with retained markers; three disclosures explain fictional booking, filters and no saved reservation data.
refinement.review: docs/LUNE_EDITORIAL_VERIFICATION.md records historical September evidence, not verification of the October refinement. Booking behavior is unchanged. Current QA must be confirmed separately.
refinement.publication: Publication and live verification of the October refinement are not established by this design record.

components.css: .ds-slot{position:relative;display:inline-block;cursor:pointer;color:#18343b;font:400 .94rem/1.65 Manrope,sans-serif}.ds-slot input{position:absolute;opacity:0;width:1px;height:1px}.ds-slot span{display:block;min-height:48px;padding:12px 16px;border:1px solid #789097;border-radius:2px;transition:transform 120ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1)}.ds-slot input:checked+span{background:#18343b;color:#fff;border-color:#18343b}.ds-slot input:focus-visible+span{outline:3px solid #295f86;outline-offset:4px}@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.ds-slot:hover span{border-color:#18343b}}:host-context(html[data-input=pointer]) .ds-slot:active span{transform:scale(.98)}:host-context(html[data-input=keyboard]) .ds-slot span{transition:none}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-slot span{transition:none;transform:none!important}}

narrative.overview:
Lune pairs light paper and deep blue-green ink with Manrope headings and controls, retaining Gloock in the lowercase wordmark. A concise introduction sits beside a single interior image, followed by a tighter menu, a compact blue about-and-hours section and the established ink booking chapter.

This scoped system records the 25 October 2026 refinement in `dist/assets/restaurant.css` and restaurant HTML, with shared `site.css` and existing `restaurant.js` behavior. It supersedes earlier layout and typography descriptions in the September editorial direction. It applies only to the fictional restaurant demonstration; corporate Nortivo documentation remains separate. Publication and live verification are not established by this document.
keyCharacteristics: Gloock lowercase wordmark; Manrope headings, body and controls.
Paper hero with title and copy on the left and one rectangular room image on the right.
Tighter menu, shorter descriptive copy, tabular prices and underlined category selection.
Compact blue about-and-hours section without a repeated interior image or circular food detail.
Full-width ink booking chapter with a paper form workspace.
Persistent fictional-demo disclosure and local-only table selection.

rules.name: The Separate World Rule
rules.body: Lune tokens apply only to the restaurant demonstration; Nortivo retains its incumbent navy and blue system.

dos: Do preserve the fictional-demo disclosure in both languages.
Do keep menu changes immediate and reduced-motion behavior intact.
Do keep booking selection local and free of personal data.
Do preserve visible focus, native fields and written selection feedback.
donts: Don't apply Lune's palette to the Nortivo corporate pages.
Don't imply that demonstration confirmation reserves a real table.
Don't introduce invented customer evidence or remove image provenance.
